stories.headline: Jeremiyah Love Comes Up Lame in the Desert and Allgeier Owners Just Struck Water
stories.read: Well pardner, the Cardinals' prize rookie limped out of Thursday's dust-up with the Raiders, walked into the building Friday sorer than anybody expected, and now Mike LaFleur has him parked at least a week with no long-haul prognosis to speak of. Twenty-nine days till the opener, so this ain't a funeral, but the saloon has been payin' top dollar for Love and top dollar don't cover a rookie whose ankle is already talkin' back. Here's your play: Tyler Allgeier is sittin' out there for pocket change and James Conner is still on the ranch, and whichever one gets the reins in September is cheaper gold than anything else on the board. Don't panic-sell Love, just quit payin' the premium, and go stake the backfield behind him before the herd wakes up.

stories.headline: Nabers Rides Again and Nobody in Your Outfit Noticed
stories.read: Hold up there, this is the one worth your while. Malik Nabers took real team reps in New York, red jersey and all, and Harbaugh says full speed is comin' soon with Week 1 against Dallas the whole point of the exercise. Eleven months back that knee was in pieces, and the fellas you're ridin' against still see a busted wing and slide him down their boards. That's your vein: a fella who was fixin' to lead the league in his cut of the throws, priced like a question mark. Grab him a round before you think you need to and let 'em all wonder how you got so lucky.

stories.headline: Burden's Jogging Again in Chicago and the Discount Window Is Closing
stories.read: Doc's been watchin' this one close. Luther Burden tangled up with a corner back on the eighth and tweaked a groin, missed the whole exhibition run, and Saturday he was out there loosenin' up on the field and sprintin' clean to the end zone. Chicago expects him saddled for Carolina in Week 1, and a preseason a fella spends on the trainer's table is exactly the kind of thing that scares a greenhorn off a real strike. If somebody in your outfit is still treatin' him like damaged goods, that is free land waitin' on whoever stakes it first. Move now, because the second he catches a ball in a real game the price goes back up.
